title: Zesty Normandy Turnip Gratin
description: A creamy, caramelized turnip gratin seasoned with cinnamon and thyme, finished with a golden Gruyère crust. Nut‑free and perfect for meal prep.
instructions: In a skillet, heat the butter and olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cinnamon and cook for 30 seconds to release its aroma.
Pour in the white wine and vegetable stock, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the sliced turnip, thyme, salt, and pepper; cover and let the mixture simmer until the turnip is just tender, about 10 minutes.
Transfer the turnip mixture to a baking dish, spreading evenly.
Sprinkle the grated Gruyère cheese over the top to form a crust.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbling.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with a few extra thyme leaves.
